secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: JWT signing secret for auth tokens (32+ random chars). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

secrets.name: WALLET_QR_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC secret for CivicLoop QR token signing (32+ random chars, distinct from JWT_SECRET). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

secrets.name: CITY_HASH_SALT
secrets.description: Salt for hashing user IDs and IPs in city/privacy requests (random string). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for transactional emails (email verification, password reset). Optional — app boots without it but emails won't be sent. Get from https://resend.com/api-keys
